role: One recorded hit in a CombatTracker: the damage source, the tick, the pre-hit health, the fall distance and a fall-damage block name, all used only to build death messages.
scope_reason: In scope: CombatTracker.func_94550_c reads each entry's damage source and amount to pick the entity credited with a kill (EntityLivingBase.func_94060_bK: the player's score, stat.mobKills, stat.entityKilledBy); entries were built in 92 of 154 recordings. Native carries them in survival.c surv_combat (the player's tracker) and living.c's death credit (the killing blow, the only entry left at a death).

members.name: damageSrc
members.note: kind (getEntity()'s living kind, for func_94060_bK), dtype (the damageType) and name (the entity's name) per entry

members.name: field_94567_b
members.note: never read (CombatTracker keeps its own field_94555_c, surv_combat last_tick)

members.name: field_94568_c
members.note: damage, the landed amount func_94563_c returns

members.name: field_94566_e
members.note: label: func_94545_a's ladder, vines or water at the hit

members.name: field_94564_f
members.note: fall, the fighter's fallDistance at the hit

members.name: getDamageSrc
members.note: the source's type and entity (and combat_killer's kind)

notes: The entries feed the kill credit (func_94550_c through EntityLivingBase.func_94060_bK: survival.c combat_killer, idx-killcredit-s1) and the death message (CombatTracker.func_151521_b: chatmsg.c chatmsg_death, checked per row with the S02s). A killing blow clears the older entries before it is added (func_94549_h sees the fighter dead), so at a death the tracker holds that blow alone: the death.fell.assist, finish and killer lines are unreachable, and func_94544_f answers the blow itself. The held item's .item forms need a named item (an anvil, world.conf anvil = off). Recordings: chat-climbfall-s1 (ladder, vines), chat-deaths-s1 (arrow, fireball, inWall, outOfWorld), chat-deaths2-s1 (inFire, mob), chat-edge-knock-s1 (lava.player through the revenge target), chat-idx-blast-s1 (explosion.player), chat-fight-witch-s1 (indirectMagic), chat-act2-s1 (fell.accident.generic), chat-surv2-bed-s1 (fall). The tracker is not in the snapshot: a death within 100 ticks (300 in combat) of a hit taken before the snapshot tick would name what native does not know. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was client_cosmetic/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/combattracker: surv_combat no longer holds the entries (the 64-entry array aborted at the 65th, a long fight in armour or leaning on a cactus): combat_entry folds each entry into what the death reads, the last entry, func_94544_f's longest fall and the entry it answers, and func_94550_c's best living and best player by damage over kinds (combat_killer) and over names (chatmsg.c chatmsg_combat_add, killer_name), so there is no cap; cactus-armor-s1 (about 100 entries, death.attack.cactus) and night-fight-s1 (about 400, death.attack.mob, entityKilledBy.Zombie) aborted before.
